node.statement: Inline scalar case proof for the fixed coordinate l: let a=x(l) and b=y(l). If a+b>=0, then max(-(a+b),0)=0, while max(-a,0) and max(-b,0) are nonnegative, so max(-(a+b),0) <= max(-a,0)+max(-b,0). If a+b<0, then max(-(a+b),0)=-(a+b)=(-a)+(-b); also -a<=max(-a,0) and -b<=max(-b,0), hence adding the two inequalities gives max(-(a+b),0) <= max(-a,0)+max(-b,0). Substituting a=x(l), b=y(l), and (x+y)(l)=x(l)+y(l) gives the coordinate inequality with no use of node 1.1.
